plaatsen.tekst: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat
Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance
He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
